about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the lands of Talamh and relive your adventures with this marvelous OST by the acclaimed VGM composer, Gareth Coker (Ori and the Blind Forest, ARK: Survival Evolved, Halo Infinite…).

From orchestral soundscapes to thrilling boss fight themes, this soundtrack features guest tracks by Mick Gordon (DOOM 2016, Wolfenstein: The New Order, Atomic Heart...), Yuka Kitamura (Elden Ring, Dark Souls III, Dark Souls II), Motoi Sakuraba (the Dark Souls Series, Mario Golf, Star Ocean), and Rachel Hardy (Stray Gods, Eternal Strands), setting the tone for the events taking place in this cute but twisted fantasy world.

Magic may be forbidden in these lands, but the music is still truly enchanting!
